scope.implementation_start_gate: Wait for root grant after CHEST-ART-01 is complete. Do not implement during chest work.
scope.user_question_pending: Obtained at least once before permanent unlock (recommended) versus unlock even before obtaining. No answer assumed.

recommended_architecture.database: Existing ItemCatalogV5 + config/items_v5.json + config/item_v5_authoring.json already form a local read-only, versioned definition database. Cached JSON composes validated independent ItemDefinition Resources. No SQLite, external plugin, network service or second copy of Definitions is needed.
recommended_architecture.definition_owner: ItemCatalogV5 owns current definition data, IDs, versions, fingerprint, levels, art keys and roles. Codex reads all_items once per refresh and builds an in-memory id index; avoid repeating disk-hash lookup per card.
recommended_architecture.profile_owner: MetaProgression owns per-save discovered IDs, permanent unlock IDs, selected starting ID and notes ledger. Do not put progress in ItemCatalogV5 static caches, art resources, HomeScene or RunInventory.
recommended_architecture.run_owner: RunInventory still owns transient instances and grant-source receipts; EquipmentService/BuildState still own equipment and effects. Home unlock/selection never grants core abilities or auto-equips an item.
recommended_architecture.ui_owner: Use one small HomeItemCodexPresenter/view model for masked/discovered rows and session-scoped requests, attached by DemoApp. DemoMenu renders requests only; do not introduce a generic event bus or new permanent wallet.
recommended_architecture.policy_data: One proposed config/home_item_unlocks.json keyed by definition ID declares positive integer unlock_notes, unlock_enabled and starter_enabled, policy version, and the answered discovery prerequisite. Missing policy row is unavailable with an explicit reason, never a free-code-default unlock. Prices are adjustable experiment data, not a new economy balance claim.

existing_interfaces.finding: Independent Definitions, data authoring, disabled appearance_weight=0 and retained canonical definitions already support read-only database lookup. No meta ownership fields exist here.

Current authoritative notes/upgrades/receipts/settlement owner. There is no standalone MetaState class in this path. _transaction currently treats every non-notes request as an upgrade: add explicit request kinds instead of smuggling item unlocks through upgrade IDs.

Current schema2/content plains_meta_1, native user://plains_meta.json and Web gunman_rush.plains_meta.v2 key; profile_id is fixed local. Atomic native temp+readback+backup+rename and Web write/readback are reusable. Blocked/future saves must not be overwritten.

New grants record source/definition/version/origin/fingerprint/level/upgraded; same source replays without revision increase. New growth source increments level on the same instance. changed is deferred presentation notification, not a committed ownership event.

Actual ownership boundary wraps inventory with a savepoint and rolls back if equipped effects cannot refresh. Discovery must occur only after the whole successful add/upgrade, not inside raw inventory.add_item before rollback can occur.
Committed item reward source is reward:<offer.source_id>, origin reward; EconomyReceipt exposes item_id/instance_id/event_id. Replays return REPLAY before claimed is emitted.
Committed purchase source is shop:<transaction_id>, origin shop; purse/stock rollback if build.add_item fails. Existing item purchase and reroll/repair receipt identities remain separate.

start_demo checks HOME then creates a new run prefix/actor/build/wallet/services and finally director.start. Cleanup clears run inventory and wallet only. Meta owner survives normal run end; existing permanent upgrade UI already spends through it.

field_rules: Store sorted unique stable-ID sets; do not save Definitions, icons, current item levels, effect_state, cooldowns or run receipts as permanent item ownership.
Discovery is a boolean set, not an acquisition counter. No per-acquisition discovery receipt growth.
Selected starting ID is zero or one string. Persisting the last choice is a reasonable candidate convenience, not a confirmed requirement.
Unlocked IDs and discovered IDs remain distinct. Do not infer discovery merely from unlocking; only actual successful acquisition reveals the item.

Do not enforce unlocked subset of discovered when loading old data: a later change of unlock policy must not erase legitimate historical unlocks. Apply the current discovered prerequisite to new purchases only.
Retain disabled/retired/orphan historical IDs without granting invalid content; current quotes/start validation reject missing or disabled definitions with a reason.

Per-save state belongs to the current MetaProgression/save adapter. Current product has one local profile per native path/browser origin, not a multi-slot UI. Native configurable profile paths can be tested independently; Web path strings alone do not isolate profiles because the current WEB_KEY is fixed. Do not claim multi-slot Web support.

save_evolution.proposal: Use an explicit schema3 migration for the current v2 profile, preserving notes, vitality upgrades, receipts, settlements and revision; add empty item-progress fields as defaults. Do not silently rely on optional unknown payload fields under schema2: older code would discard them on its next save.
save_evolution.storage_key: Keep the current physical native path and Web storage key as stable storage locations for the local profile, or explicitly migrate them. Simply switching WEB_KEY to a fresh v3 key would make the existing save appear empty. Envelope version is the format boundary.
save_evolution.older_client_protection: A v3 envelope at the existing key makes the current v2 loader reject future_schema before backup fallback/write, preserving the newer profile. Retain that guard and per-schema content/checksum rules.
save_evolution.current_history_recovery_candidate: Validated existing settled[*].summary.items and last_summary.items may contain actual V5-owned IDs from prior ended runs. A pure migration may union only valid, evidenced item IDs into discovered (not unlock them). Do not infer from reward candidates, equipment capability declarations, or guess legacy-to-V5 ID aliases. Missing evidence stays unknown.
save_evolution.failure: Invalid/malformed/future saves remain blocked/recoverable under existing semantics; never reset to a blank profile as a convenience. Tests must keep native backup/corrupt preservation and Web storage rejection behavior.

proposed_methods.behavior: Validated acquisition caller adds the ID to a set and commits once; known ID is an idempotent no-op. No unbounded discovery receipt ledger.
Return available/reason, positive notes price, policy/version fingerprint and profile revision, discovered/unlocked/current-content state. Disabled/missing/unpriced content is unavailable.

Explicit item_unlock transaction kind. Validate caller/session in App, request identity/replay, current quote and requirements, then deduct notes and add unlock in one detached candidate and one _commit. Save failure leaves both notes and unlock unchanged. Existing receipt ID+different request conflicts; exact replay never spends twice.
Validate unlocked/current/starter-enabled ID or explicit empty choice. Update only the selected field; no notes cost, no ownership grant, no ability/stat changes. Same selection is a no-op.

Only current HOME, current Home instance, blocked Home walk input and current relics/departure-picker panel/session may submit. Closing, changing page, focus loss, entering a run or replacing Home invalidates session/old buttons. No reliance on run EquipmentService pause sessions while in Home.

discovery_trigger.recommended: Add a narrow committed ownership signal/result at BuildState.add_item after inventory add+equipped refresh succeeds, only when a new source changed inventory.revision. Emit an immutable source receipt. Alternatively use the committed reward/shop receipts plus an explicit Home starter grant callback, but do not fork the grant rules across every UI.
discovery_trigger.must_not_use: RunInventory.changed alone: it is intentionally presentation-only, also fires for state changes, and can be queued before an owning transaction restores a savepoint. Do not count repair, equip, inventory load, open/view or source replay as obtaining.
discovery_trigger.app_validation: Current run/build identity, actual source_receipt/item/instance match, origin and live ownership after full commit. Connect only the real formal save consumer; diagnostics/previews use isolated or memory-only profiles.
discovery_trigger.failure_ordering: Run acquisition and disk-backed permanent discovery are separate resources. Candidate default: do not remove an already accepted run item when discovery persistence fails. Keep a bounded in-memory dirty discovered-ID set, retry with the next successful profile commit/Home entry, and expose unsaved status. Do not claim crash durability while storage rejects writes. Unlock/notes transactions remain all-or-none.

candidates_confirmed_by_root: At most one selected unlocked item, Lv1, first enters this run backpack, never automatically equips.
Unlock once with permanent notes; future runs may select/reuse it without spending notes again.
Backpack capacity/load and present equipment prerequisites are not carry prerequisites. Applicable weapon/core restrictions may be described; real equipping still uses original equipment validation.
A permanent Home item unlock does not grant any core major ability.
Disabled content retains discovery/unlock history but blocks new unlocking/carry with a reason.
sequence: While still in Home, validate selected ID and profile state before destroying Home. Freeze one current Definition snapshot plus policy fingerprint, or accept explicit none.
Create the fresh run namespace/actor/build/services using the existing start_demo path; validate inventory ownership only, not offer/equip suitability.
Grant exactly once with source <run_receipt_prefix>/home_starter/slot_0, origin home_starter, through BuildState.add_item. Fresh inventory makes its level1; do not copy last-run level/effect_state.

Record a versioned starting-loadout output in the run Manifest before first reward/shop pool generation. Include ID, level1, definition version/fingerprint and source receipt for reproducibility; this is not a mid-run save.

If start construction/director.start fails, clean up the new run attempt and return Home with selection/unlock/notes unchanged. A rejected attempt must not leave a partial actor or consumed permanent item.
Cross maps/regions/environment fallback keeps the same owned instance; do not grant in _load_stage, _stage_entered or return-to-home paths.
True run end clears transient inventory under existing cleanup. A later distinct run gets one fresh Lv1 instance with a distinct run prefix; the permanent unlock and chosen ID remain.
rejections: Unknown/deleted item, disabled or starter-disabled content, missing policy/definition, not unlocked, wrong type, multiple IDs, level other than1, stale profile/quote/UI session, non-Home entry or terminal/pending invalid run context.
Do not use ItemV5Eligibility.offer_reason as a starter-carry filter; it enforces weapon/grapple/random-offer rules that are not backpack ownership requirements.
If a previously selected ID becomes disabled or unavailable, show a clear reason and let the user clear/change it; do not silently replace it or charge again.

real_home_entry.activation_proposal: After chest work, activate the existing relics slot without moving platforms/physics. An existing archivist keeper asset can serve this function; final naming/art is separate. Add HomeScene.FUNCTION_NAMES entry before making the slot active, so the grounded interaction prompt has a valid label.
real_home_entry.route: Actual Home walking/jumping to the existing tier -> nearest_candidate current90/115x hysteresis and32wu vertical gate -> W/left-stick-up/INTERACT -> HomeScene.requested_interaction(relics) -> DemoApp._open_home_function -> DemoMenu.show_home_panel(relics).
real_home_entry.do_not_repurpose: Keep the active achievements / 钟之档案 placeholder independent. It is at x920/y240 and has its own function ID; relics is the actual reserved location matching this request.
real_home_entry.menu: One responsive scroll grid with unknown question-mark rows and discovered cards using current ItemPresentation/art. Known cards show actual effects, unlocked/selected badges, explicit permanent notes cost and separate unlock/select actions. Unknown cards must not leak names/icons/effects via tooltip/accessibility/action labels. No purchase on open/hover.
real_home_entry.departure: Extend the existing departure panel with one slot preview and a reusable filtered unlocked-item picker (or return to relics to choose). Selected action only persists one choice; BEGIN grants it once. Support explicit none; refresh does not spend or grant.
real_home_entry.input: Reuse current Home input block/router clear/neutral re-arm and UI focus/touch scrolling; UI uses always processing as current menus do. Closing must not replay jump/shoot/interact or auto-confirm BEGIN. No global time-scale writes from the grid.

pending_unlock_rule_branches.obtained_first: Unknown entries remain question marks and cannot unlock. After actual saved discovery, details and a priced unlock button become available. This is recommended but not yet answered.
pending_unlock_rule_branches.unlock_before_obtaining: Do not automatically reveal merely because unlocked: user still required unobtained entries to be question marks. Selection from an unlocked unknown entry and its information/price disclosure must be clearly designed; first real Home-starter grant can create discovery. Wait for root/user answer before dependent implementation.

cases: Currentv2->newversion preserves notes/upgrades/receipts/settled/revision and adds item fields; available prior settled.item evidence only becomes discovered, never unlocked.

Native two profile paths remain isolated; no static catalogue discovery leaks. Web current local profile retains existing key and normal refresh state. If a multi-profile adapter is introduced, distinct profile IDs/keys must isolate it explicitly.
Corrupt/truncated/backup/future version/write rejection behavior remains; save failure cannot spend notes without unlock or unlock without durable spend.
Real cache/Boss reward, shop purchase and same-instance level growth record the actual ID; first acquisition reveals, later acquisitions do not grow counters or discovery receipts.
Same source replay, inventory reload, equipment toggle, repair, view/open/close, declined or rolled-back grant do not add discoveries.
Death-priority rejected reward does not discover; actual acquisition followed by later death keeps the discovery. Failed persistence is displayed/retried, never reported saved.
Correct notes debit+flag atomic commit; insufficient notes, unknown/deleted/disabled/unpriced content, discovered requirement branch, stale quote/profile/session and malformed requests reject.
Same transaction request replays without charge; changed payload with same ID conflicts; concurrent/double-click unlock intents never charge twice.
Already-unlocked selection/reuse is free; coin wallet, vitality upgrades, weapons and major abilities are unaffected.
Zero or one unlocked Lv1 definition goes to fresh backpack; no auto-equip, no stat/HP/ammo/ability benefit before real equipment.
A5gear item or temporarily unmet weapon/core/equipment-tag requirement still may be carried; actual equipment validation remains.
Start button replay and map entry do not regrant. Cross-map/region/environment fallback retains same instance/source; true end clears only run item; next run fresh level1 once.
Stale/disabled/unlocked-state change rejects before Home teardown; rejected startup leaves no partial run or permanent spend.
Same seed/starting choice/weapon yields stable recorded offer manifest independent of random run receipt prefix; changed starting ownership legitimately changes eligibility and must be recorded.
Native actual movement to relics, same-tier grounded interaction, panel close/back and departure selection; other reserved slots and achievements stay independent.
Question-mark masking includes tooltip/focus text; discovered details/current note balance/explicit price/errors/selection update after commit.
1280x720 and960x540 scrolling plus actual mouse/gamepad/touch requests; no stale callbacks or first gameplay action leak after close/focus loss.

necessary_checks.note: These are proposed affected checks, not executed results. New focused HomeCodex/profile tests should be registered additively. Existing core/home suites carry meta_notes_save_tests and Home app/UI/weapon contracts; do not invent nonexistent standalone Harness IDs or remove their current guards.

implementation_order_after_grant: Freeze answered unlock prerequisite and data policy/schema migration contract.
Add MetaProgression discovery/unlock/selection fields and pure save migration with existing notes commit tests.
Connect one authoritative committed-ownership boundary and once-per-run starter admission; add lifecycle/manifest/cross-profile tests before UI.
Activate actual relics slot and render masked codex/unlock/select/departure UI with existing art; test real input/scroll paths.
Run selected original Harness plus dedicated native and Web persistence refresh checks; archive exact source/evidence. Never reuse prior unrelated CI as this feature acceptance.
remaining_uncertainty: User answer for discovery-before-unlock is pending.
Final notes prices/content policy not chosen; store adjustable experiment values in data and do not rebalance vitality/notes systems here.
Selection persistence across refresh is a candidate convenience; current Home weapon selection remains a separate session-only system.
Current product has one local save, no cloud sync or multi-slot UI.
No implementation or verification is performed by this readiness report.
